name: Persistent Config
description: Persist selected home-relative configuration directories using a generic host-backed user directory or the project workspace

scope.description: Persistence scope. 'user': use a generic host-backed persistence root. 'workspace': use project directories such as /workspace/.codex.

dirs.description: Comma or whitespace separated home-relative directories to persist, such as '.codex,.claude,.config/gh'. Entries must be relative paths.
